info.title: Family Safety — BEFE / Guardian Upstream API
info.description: App-facing (upstream) BEFE/Guardian API for Family Safety. Covers B01-B74 from the FSC BEFE API Requirements (13 Figma pages): eligibility, subscription, onboarding, circle & home aggregate, members & invites, permissions, member page, check-ins, SOS, fraud alerts, device safety, parental controls, settings & roles, alerts & history, signals & lifecycle. Requests/responses with mandatory fields. Routes are proposals (/befe/fsc/v1) pending Guardian registration. The BEFE orchestrates FSC (/fsc), Whalebone, Network/Billing downstreams.
